rationale: Chief Justice Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion to a narrow, administrable Watson-based holding that WWII procurement and generalized federal coordination are too attenuated from the specific dredging/canal/restoration allegations to satisfy the “acting under” and nexus requirements. A short concurrence is most likely from Justice Gorsuch (and possibly Justice Thomas) to emphasize textual limits and avoid turning § 1442 into a broad removal hook for ordinary state-law suits.
